name: dane-live-enable-closes-idle-plaintext
between_ticks_sql: UPDATE feature_toggles SET enabled=true WHERE key IN ('feature.dnssec','feature.dane'); INSERT INTO outbound_queue(id,message_id,from_addr,rcpt_addrs,raw_ref,mailbox_id,message_pk) SELECT 9350012,'<live-second@smtp3.test>',from_addr,rcpt_addrs,raw_ref,mailbox_id,message_pk FROM outbound_queue WHERE id=9350011;
teardown_sql: DO $$BEGIN IF to_regclass('public.gofree_smtp4_toggle_backup') IS NOT NULL THEN DELETE FROM feature_toggles WHERE key IN ('feature.dnssec','feature.dane','feature.mta_sts','feature.tls_rpt'); INSERT INTO feature_toggles SELECT * FROM public.gofree_smtp4_toggle_backup; DROP TABLE public.gofree_smtp4_toggle_backup; END IF; END$$;
